channel.title: Codehimblog – New software listings
channel.description: Codehimblog is an independent directory of free and open-source Windows software. Compare features, check Windows compatibility and find official download sources.

item.title: Frame Player – System Utilities
item.description: A video player for Windows that plays local files, web links, and torrent streams, with support for casting, subtitle search, and synchronized watching with friends.

item.title: Lyrenne – System Utilities
item.description: A free, open‑source YouTube Music desktop player for Windows.

item.title: Nagi – System Utilities
item.description: A fast, private music player for your local library on Windows, with Navidrome and Jellyfin streaming

item.title: Skrin – System Utilities
item.description: A free, open‑source local media library and video player that organizes movies and TV shows on your computer or NAS without a server or account.

item.title: VLC Media Player Redesign – Audio & Video
item.description: An unofficial build of VLC 4 that keeps the original VLC engine and codecs but replaces the interface with a new design by Juxtopposed.

item.title: VLC Win10smtc – System Utilities
item.description: A plugin that adds Windows System Media Transport Controls integration to VLC Media Player.

item.title: AeroZoom – System Utilities
item.description: Keyboard‑free screen magnifier for Windows that lets you zoom with the mouse wheel or pinch gestures and provides a panel for presentation‑style controls.

item.title: AF Media Bar – System Utilities
item.description: A taskbar media controller that shows media information, lyrics and playback controls directly on the desktop.

item.title: AppGroup – System Utilities
item.description: App Group lets you organize, customize, and launch your apps.

item.title: Astraeus – System Utilities
item.description: A native Windows dashboard that slides out from the edge of the screen, providing quick access to media, system controls and widgets.

item.title: AutoRunManager – System Utilities
item.description: A utility that lets you view, add, remove, backup and restore programs that run automatically when Windows starts.

item.title: BleachBit – System Utilities
item.description: BleachBit is a system cleaner that removes unnecessary files to free disk space and protect privacy.

item.title: Desktop Bubble Chat – System Utilities
item.description: Floating chat head application that lets you run multiple messenger accounts in lightweight, movable windows on your desktop.

item.title: DeskX Wallpaper Engine – System Utilities
item.description: A lightweight Windows utility that lets you set images, GIFs, videos, or HTML pages as live wallpapers and adds draggable interactive widgets with multi‑monitor support.

item.title: electerm – System Utilities
item.description: Free and open‑source client for terminal, SSH, SFTP, FTP, Telnet, serial port, RDP, VNC and Spice connections.

item.title: FFmpeg GUI Editor Windows – System Utilities
item.description: A lightweight portable graphical front‑end for FFmpeg that lets Windows users trim, crop, compress, convert and edit videos without using the command line.

item.title: Fk Desktop – System Utilities
item.description: Fk Desktop is a Pomodoro timer that follows the original technique closely, offering a classic desktop UI, keyboard shortcuts and advanced settings for power users.

item.title: Formatix Image Converter – System Utilities
item.description: A fast, lightweight, offline batch image converter and resizer for Windows that supports many formats and offers quality control.

item.title: HardwareVisualizer – System Utilities
item.description: A cross‑platform hardware monitor with real‑time metrics, local history, and customizable dashboards.

item.title: Headroom Desktop – System Utilities
item.description: Headroom Desktop is a tray application that reduces token usage for Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex and similar AI coding tools by about half.

item.title: InstallerClean – System Utilities
item.description: Open source tool to safely clean orphaned Windows Installer files and reclaim disk space.

item.title: Jenv – System Utilities
item.description: Jenv is a command‑line tool that lets you manage multiple Java versions on your computer, allowing easy switching, adding, and removal of JDK installations.

item.title: Lap – System Utilities
item.description: An offline-first photo manager for large local libraries

item.title: LibreGet – System Utilities
item.description: LibreGet is a free open‑source download manager and media toolbox for Windows that can download files from courses, YouTube, social sites and many other services, then transcribe, convert and organise the saved content.

item.title: LucidDesk – System Utilities
item.description: LucidDesk is a free, open‑source tool that lets you organize desktop icons into panels, create folder panels, search files with Everything, and preview files with PowerToys Peek.

item.title: Mcp Windows – System Utilities
item.description: A server that lets AI agents control Windows applications through UI Automation, enabling clicks, typing, and reading of controls without relying on screen coordinates.

item.title: mDNS-Browser – System Utilities
item.description: A graphical tool for browsing services advertised via mDNS on the local network.

item.title: Metrolist – Audio & Video
item.description: Metrolist is a free, open‑source YouTube Music client that runs on Windows, letting you stream music and videos without ads.

item.title: Moonlight Qt – System Utilities
item.description: Moonlight Qt is an open‑source client that lets you stream games and desktop sessions from a PC with NVIDIA GameStream or Sunshine to your Windows computer.

item.title: Mouse Point Viewer – System Utilities
item.description: A desktop application that displays mouse coordinates relative to any window visible on the screen.

item.title: MouseX Absolute Mouse Control – System Utilities
item.description: A lightweight Windows utility that lets you remap mouse buttons, scroll wheels and extra buttons to keyboard shortcuts, chords and repeating macros, with per‑application profiles.

item.title: MyNotes – System Utilities
item.description: A simple notes and reminders application for Windows built with WinUI 3.

item.title: PhotoSlide – Graphics & Image Editing
item.description: PhotoSlide is a simple photo management and editing program with a modern JavaFX interface, aimed at users who need basic organization and light editing without a subscription model.

item.title: PyMusicPlayer – System Utilities
item.description: A Windows music player with audio analysis, waveform seek bar, and support for many audio formats and internet radio.

item.title: Quiesce – System Utilities
item.description: Quiesce safely cleans Windows temporary files, system logs, update caches, and optimizes system memory without heavy installers or background processes.

item.title: Sakura Editor – System Utilities
item.description: A free, open‑source text editor for Windows with support for many file encodings and customizable features.

item.title: ScreenRecorder – System Utilities
item.description: A simple program that records your screen and audio.

item.title: Scribe – System Utilities
item.description: Scribe is an offline voice-to-text desktop assistant that lets you dictate, control apps and run custom commands with your voice.

item.title: ScriptReader – System Utilities
item.description: ScriptReader converts scanned handwritten JPEG images into formatted RTF documents and removes handwritten typos automatically.

item.title: StarLuxe – System Utilities
item.description: A launcher that helps apply ReShade shaders to selected games.

item.title: Sucrose – System Utilities
item.description: Sucrose is an open‑source wallpaper engine that lets you run interactive, media‑responsive wallpapers on your desktop.

item.title: TizuMark – System Utilities
item.description: A lightweight Markdown editor for Windows with live preview, outline navigation, KaTeX and Mermaid support.

item.title: Token Tracker – System Utilities
item.description: A local dashboard that tracks token usage and cost for many AI coding tools, with a system‑tray app, desktop pet, widgets and achievement tracking.

item.title: Traydio – System Utilities
item.description: A tiny, simple, elegant internet radio player that lives in the Windows tray.

item.title: TuneFree – System Utilities
item.description: A tool that decrypts QQ Music's encrypted .mflac and .mgg files and converts them to MP3 or FLAC on Windows.

item.title: Universal Intel Chipset Updater – System Utilities
item.description: A security‑focused tool that automatically detects Intel hardware and installs the latest official chipset INF files safely.

item.title: Universal Intel Wi-Fi and Bluetooth Drivers Updater – System Utilities
item.description: A tool that automatically detects Intel Wi‑Fi and Bluetooth hardware and installs the latest official drivers with security checks.

item.title: Usque – System Utilities
item.description: An unofficial client for Cloudflare WARP services that provides system VPN, SOCKS5 and HTTP proxy with advanced routing, chain proxy, and profile management.

item.title: VoxType – System Utilities
item.description: Privacy‑focused open‑source AI voice typing for Windows.

item.title: Warpinator Windows – System Utilities
item.description: An unofficial implementation of Warpinator for Windows.
